scenes.label: Meet Kabir
scenes.title: A silly family secret?
scenes.caption: Meet Kabir. It's Sunday, and he's beating Mum at carrom while the family chat buzzes with jokes. Uncle Vikram has just posted another funny cooking video. Last month, after a news story about voice-cloning scams, Kabir's parents set up a family passphrase: a secret phrase only the family knows. Kabir thought it was a bit silly.

scenes.label: The voice note
scenes.title: It sounds exactly like him.
scenes.caption: Right in the middle of their game, Mum's phone buzzes. It's a voice note from an unknown number. The voice is Uncle Vikram's, shaky and scared. There's been an accident. His phone is broken. Send ₹20,000 now, and don't tell anyone. Mum's hands shake. Kabir's heart pounds. It sounds exactly like him, and every second feels urgent.
scenes.speech: Right in the middle of their game, Mum's phone buzzes. It's a voice note from an unknown number. The voice is Uncle Vikram's, shaky and scared. There's been an accident. His phone is broken. Send twenty thousand rupees now, and don't tell anyone. Mum's hands shake. Kabir's heart pounds. It sounds exactly like him, and every second feels urgent.
scenes.dialogue: That sounds exactly like Uncle Vikram…

scenes.label: Spot the clues
scenes.title: Wait. Is it really him?
scenes.caption: Kabir takes a breath. A familiar voice isn't proof. With just a few seconds of a video posted online, AI tools can copy how someone sounds. That's called voice cloning. Then there's the unknown number, the rush and the secrecy. One clue alone doesn't prove a scam, but together they say: stop and check. And Kabir remembers the family passphrase.

scenes.dialogue: Wait, Mum. Let’s ask for our passphrase.

scenes.label: Verify first
scenes.title: Ask. Then call back.
scenes.caption: Your turn. Help Kabir and Mum find out who's really asking. Choose a reply that only the real Uncle Vikram could answer. Then watch closely. If the voice dodges, think about which number you can truly trust. Don't argue with the sender, and don't send money. Remember: sounding right isn't the same as being right.

scenes.label: The real uncle
scenes.title: The voice was a copy.
scenes.caption: Uncle Vikram picks up on his saved number. He's fine, at work, and his phone was never broken. The voice note was a clone. Mum blocks the unknown number and reports it at cybercrime.gov.in. If money is ever sent, call 1930 straight away. And the passphrase stays offline: said aloud at home, never posted or typed in chats.

scenes.dialogue: His voice was copied. Our passphrase wasn’t.

scenes.label: A happier ending
scenes.title: Rematch night!
scenes.caption: That night, Uncle Vikram comes over for dinner and a carrom rematch. He's glad everyone checked. Kabir doesn't think the passphrase is silly anymore. A familiar voice isn't proof. Pause, tell a trusted adult, ask for the passphrase, and call back on a number you already trust. Your turn: help Kabir practise checking urgent voice notes.
scenes.dialogue: Passphrase first, then call back. Always.
